_doc: Presentation only (src/render/hero.js). How the hero carries each weapon type when not attacking, and the arc a melee swing follows. Positions are the right palm in the hero's body space (x left, y up, z forward, metres); dir is where the weapon's long axis points (blade or shaft tip). two = the left hand also holds it (used when nothing is in the left hand), with grip = where along the weapon the left palm goes (metres from the right palm, + toward the head). one = the carry with a shield or second weapon in the left hand. castHold keeps the weapon's carry angle (not the palm position) through spell actions, so a staff stays upright while the arm gestures. swing.radius is the right palm's distance from the body axis during a swing; actions.js swing keys give the angle (0 forward, + to the hero's left), blade elevation and palm height.
